Formulation
Current presentation characterized by a 3-day history of severe, persistent headache with photophobia and visual phenomena (“shooting light”), partially responsive to ibuprofen, affecting work functioning and energy. No mental health symptoms were elicited or documented. Predisposing factor includes family history of migraine (mother). Precipitating factor: sudden onset of headache. Perpetuating factors: ongoing pain and light sensitivity. Protective factor: help-seeking behavior (contacted GP). Further assessment planned via in-person neurological examination and fundoscopy; blood pressure to be checked due to contraceptive pill use and possible migraine with aura consideration.
